purpose: Find the earliest public epoch in the relevant HA10 archive where all six EDH channels can be retrieved simultaneously under a value-blind transport scan, then freeze the first twenty complete six-channel 600-second windows and characterize their raw-first baseline/coupling morphology without calling the epoch instrument-clean.

known_archive_context_before_gate.frozen_2013_waveform_requests: 240/240 HTTP 404 no-data on the exact preregistered windows
known_archive_context_before_gate.later_reference_epoch: 2014-12 through 2015-01 has public H10N1/H10S2 waveform evidence in existing JANUS runs
known_archive_context_before_gate.earthscope_availability_service_state: The legacy fdsnws-availability service is publicly documented as temporarily unavailable since 2026-07-27; this gate therefore uses a value-blind dataselect transport scan rather than pretending StationXML availability equals waveform availability.

forbidden_during_discovery: reading or summarizing waveform sample amplitudes
manual date preference after seeing signal values
discovery_contract.earliest_probe_day_rule: Choose the chronologically earliest daily 12:00 UTC one-second probe for which all six channels are returned on the same calendar date.
discovery_contract.full_window_freeze_rule: Starting at that earliest probe day and moving strictly forward one UTC day at a time, request the six fixed 12:00-12:10 UTC windows and inspect only header/time completeness. Freeze the first 20 dates complete on all six channels. Stop after 120 calendar days. No replacement outside this deterministic forward scan.

per_channel: median raw integrated 10-80 Hz power across selected windows
median public-response-corrected integrated 10-80 Hz power where response metadata are available
cross_station: median raw H10S2-minus-H10N1 10-80 Hz power ratio in dB
median corrected H10S2-minus-H10N1 ratio in dB
within_triplet_coupling: mean 10-80 Hz magnitude-squared coherence per window for S1-S2, S1-S3, S2-S3
epoch medians reported without causal promotion

predeclared_baseline_classification.EARLY_LARGE_S2_N1_BASELINE_SIMILAR_TO_20: Early raw S2/N1 median >=6 dB and differs from the frozen 2014 raw median by <=3 dB.
predeclared_baseline_classification.EARLY_S2_N1_BASELINE_MATERIALLY_LOWER_TH: Early raw S2/N1 median <6 dB and frozen 2014 raw median >=6 dB.
predeclared_baseline_classification.BLOCKED: Fewer than 15 complete selected six-channel windows or no simultaneous six-channel daily probe exists before the frozen horizon.

interpretation_firewall.reason: Published H10 literature reports a distinct earlier data-logger electronic-noise phenomenon during roughly 2005-2009; therefore an early epoch is a temporal baseline, not a clean control by assumption.

after_result: Freeze the exact result append-only, then submit it and the updated whole-picture synthesis to the JANUS 17-role reverse council for exactly one next discriminating gate.
